commentary: With market breadth deteriorating to 46 and the benchmark Nifty stumbling on an unexpected RBI rate hike and surging crude, the deterministic gate flashes CAUTION. In William O'Neil's framework, an index under distribution alongside macro headwinds demands defensive posture and progressive exposure discipline. Stan Weinstein's stage principles dictate that even when individual names demonstrate Stage 2 contours, broader market pressure increases base breakout failure rates. Capital preservation supersedes aggression: exposure must be kept tight, overhead supply respected, and cash held until broad institutional accumulation reappears.

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Consolidating within a tight 30-session box above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200, pressing its 20-session pivot. Volume characteristics lack institutional sponsorship.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Sub-par fundamental profile with operating margins under 2% and 3-year average ROE at 3.1%. Fails CANSLIM institutional and earnings quality criteria.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Hard stop at 99.05; violation breaches box support and triggers Minervini-style risk preservation.

ABDL.technical: Maintains Stage 2 posture above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200, testing neckline resistance with RSI 70 indicating firm underlying momentum.
ABDL.fundamental: Despite prestige whisky volume traction, Q1 FY27 net profit fell 18.7% YoY. Valuation is rich at ~87x P/E with elevated receivables.
ABDL.risk: Cut immediately below 693.33; a break violates swing-low support and threatens the intermediate trend.

ACE.technical: Superb Trend Template alignment above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. Sits within 1.5% of its pivot with aligned swing lows and positive MACD.
ACE.fundamental: Dominant 63%+ market share in mobile cranes. Balance sheet is virtually debt-free with a stellar 31.6% ROCE and 20.5% EBITDA margins.
ACE.risk: Exit strictly below 1184.64; breakdown compromises the 50-SMA and invalidates base pivot structure.

ACMESOLAR.technical: Textbook double-bottom continuation above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. Bullish reclaim candle off the rising 21-EMA with RSI 63 signals strong institutional accumulation.
ACMESOLAR.fundamental: Aggressive BESS and solar commissioning drove Q1 FY27 net profit up 79.9% YoY on 67.8% top-line expansion. Heavy capex is offset by robust operating leverage.
ACMESOLAR.risk: Disciplined exit at 435.78; breach of the 21-EMA and swing trough ends the technical thesis.

ADANIPORTS.technical: Holding cleanly above key moving averages (EMA21, SMA50, SMA200). Rebound candle off the rising 21-EMA shows orderly consolidation with RSI 58.
ADANIPORTS.fundamental: Industry titan with domestic port EBITDA margins near 74% and net debt-to-EBITDA around 1.9x. However, quarterly EPS growth is modest at 10.2% YoY.
ADANIPORTS.risk: Thesis invalid below 1771.57; falling below the pivot neckline damages primary support.

ADFFOODS.technical: SEPA breakout clearing 20-session highs on heavy 4.45× volume expansion, firmly positioned above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with positive MACD.
ADFFOODS.fundamental: Solid 25.9% revenue growth powered by international distribution, but freight inflation compressed EBITDA margins to 17.7%, decelerating profit growth to 13.4%.
ADFFOODS.risk: Stop loss at 308.38; price falling back into base marks breakout failure requiring immediate liquidation.
